# OpusFileOptions

[DotGame.AudioCodecs](README.md) · `DotGame.AudioCodecs.Opus` · class

```csharp
public sealed class OpusFileOptions
```

The settings of an Ogg Opus file that aren't the encoder's.

## Properties

### Comments

```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<string> Comments { get; init; }
```

Comments, each "KEY=value" (opusenc's `--comment`), after the vendor string.

### MaxPageDelay

```csharp
public TimeSpan MaxPageDelay { get; init; }
```

The longest a packet waits before its page is written (opusenc's `--max-delay`): 0 to 1 second, the default. Shorter pages cost a little size but let a stream be played sooner.

### Serial

```csharp
public int Serial { get; init; }
```

The Ogg stream's serial number (opusenc's `--serial`). opusenc picks one at random; the default here is 0, so the same samples always give the same file.
